resources.string: Lets Comitra hold you to a goal by blocking the app you chose (and its website) until the goal is done. Comitra checks only which app is in the foreground, and the address bar while you are in a browser. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
You blocked it yourself to finish a goal. It unlocks as soon as the goal is done.
You blocked %1$s to finish a goal, so its website is blocked too. It unlocks as soon as the goal is done.
There is no skip button on purpose. Finish the goal in Comitra, or turn the blocking permission off in Android Settings.
